result.title: Scaling Vision Transformers Without Training: Prune-and-Merge Token Compression
result.comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop at NeurIPS 2026; 12 pages
result.summary: Vision Transformers achieve strong performance but incur high computational costs from quadratic token interactions. Training-free token reduction methods improve efficiency, but their robustness remains underexplored. We propose Prune-and Merge ViT, a training-free framework for off-the-shelf models. It combines class attention-based pruning with similarity-based merging to reduce redundancy while preserving semantic information. To evaluate robustness we introduce two metrics. Relative Accuracy Drop (RAD) measures relative accuracy degradation under transformations, and Prediction Flip Rate (PFR) quantifies prediction consistency. On pretrained ViT and DeiT, Prune-and-Merge reduces computation competitively while maintaining robustness and better accuracy than existing token reduction methods. Our analysis suggests that hybrid token reduction does not introduce hallucination-like behavior and preserves prediction stability for common image transformations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 Prune-and-Merge ViT 框架，用类别注意力剪枝结合相似度合并压缩视觉 token，并引入 RAD 与 PFR 两个指标衡量模型在图像变换下的精度退化与预测一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其注意力引导剪枝与相似度合并直接涉及「保留哪些视觉证据」，可能与 LVR 的视觉证据筛选及内部状态是否留存必要细节相关；RAD/PFR 或可供核查用于评估 latent 状态在输入扰动下的稳定性，但原文并未涉及多模态推理。
